verdict.rationale: Bench documents automated data pulls, transaction categorization, and a form of automatic reconciliation (separating merchant fees) that feeds into real-time reports, but the actual month-end close and exception handling is performed by human bookkeepers with software assistance, not an autonomous agent preparing the close for human review — the model is inverted from the story's ask. Missing for 10: evidence of an agent independently matching transactions and flagging exceptions, an actual review workflow/UI for human sign-off on agent output, and any documentation of agentic (vs. human-led) month-end reconciliation.
